questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests practical use of IaC validation, sandbox environments, and secret/configuration management within a real CI/CD workflow. Emphasizes the end-to-end lifecycle from pull request to production, with automated teardown and comprehensive observability.

## Key Concepts
- Azure Pipelines YAML structure and pull request triggers
- Infrastructure as Code validation using Bicep and the Azure CLI
- Per-environment configuration via Azure App Configuration
- Secrets management via Azure Key Vault
- Container image build and deployment to isolated sandbox environments
- Production promotion with health checks
- Observability and logging with Azure Monitor

## Code Example
```yaml
# azure-pipelines.yml
trigger: none

pr:
  branches:
    include:
      - main

variables:
  - name: resourceGroup
    value: 'pr-sandbox-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)'
  - name: aksClusterName
    value: 'pr-aks-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)'
  - name: acrName
    value: 'pracr$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)'
  - name: imageName
    value: 'microservice:$(Build.BuildId)'
  - name: appConfigName
    value: 'appconfig-$(Environment)'
  - name: keyVaultName
    value: 'kv-$(Environment)'
  - name: sandboxTimeout
    value: 120  # minutes

stages:
  - stage: Validate_IaC
    displayName: 'Validate Infrastructure'
    jobs:
      - job: Deploy_Sandbox
        displayName: 'Deploy Sandbox Environment'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - checkout: self
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Deploy Sandbox Resources'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az group create -n $(resourceGroup) -l eastus
                az deployment group create \
                  --resource-group $(resourceGroup) \
                  --template-file ./infra/main.bicep \
                  --parameters clusterName=$(aksClusterName) \
                             acrName=$(acrName)
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Set Sandbox Timeout'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                # Schedule sandbox deletion in 2 hours
                az monitor activity-log alert create \
                  -n sandbox-timeout-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId) \
                  -g $(resourceGroup) \
                  --condition "category='Timer'" \
                  --action 'az group delete -n $(resourceGroup) --yes'
                sleep $(sandboxTimeout)m || true
                az group delete -n $(resourceGroup) --yes --no-wait

  - stage: Build_and_Test
    displayName: 'Build and Test'
    dependsOn: Validate_IaC
    jobs:
      - job: Build_Container
        displayName: 'Build Container Image'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Login to ACR'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az acr login -n $(acrName)
          - task: Docker@2
            displayName: 'Build and Push Image'
            inputs:
              containerRegistry: $(acrName)
              repository: $(imageName)
              command: 'buildAndPush'
              Dockerfile: '$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/Dockerfile'
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Fetch App Config and Key Vault Secrets'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                echo "##vso[task.setvariable variable=APP_CONFIG_ENDPOINT]$(az appconfig show \
                  --name $(appConfigName) --query endpoint --output tsv)"
          - task: AzureKeyVault@2
            displayName: 'Retrieve Key Vault Secrets'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
              KeyVaultName: $(keyVaultName)
              SecretsFilter: '*'
              RunAsPreJob: false
      - job: Run_Unit_Tests
        displayName: 'Execute Unit Tests'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: UseDotNet@2
            displayName: 'Setup .NET'
            inputs:
              packageType: 'sdk'
              version: '8.x'
          - script: dotnet test --logger 'trx;LogFileName=results.trx'
            displayName: 'Run Unit Tests'
          - task: PublishTestResults@2
            displayName: 'Publish Test Results'
            inputs:
              testResultsFormat: 'VSTest'
              testResultsFiles: '**/*.trx'

  - stage: Deploy_Sandbox
    displayName: 'Deploy to Sandbox'
    dependsOn: Build_and_Test
    jobs:
      - deployment: Deploy_AKS
        displayName: 'Deploy Microservice to AKS'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        environment: 'sandbox-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)'
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - task: HelmInstaller@1
                  displayName: 'Install Helm'
                - task: AzureCLI@2
                  displayName: 'Get AKS Credentials'
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
                    scriptType: 'bash'
                    scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
                    inlineScript: |
                      az aks get-credentials \
                        --resource-group $(resourceGroup) \
                        --name $(aksClusterName) \
                        --file $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/kubeconfig
                - task: Bash@3
                  displayName: 'Deploy with Helm'
                  inputs:
                    targetType: 'inline'
                    command: |
                      helm upgrade --install microservice ./charts/microservice \
                        --kubeconfig $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/kubeconfig \
                        --set image.repository=$(acrName).azurecr.io/$(imageName) \
                        --set appConfig.endpoint=$(APP_CONFIG_ENDPOINT) \
                        --wait --timeout 5m

  - stage: Health_Check
    displayName: 'Verify Deployment'
    dependsOn: Deploy_Sandbox
    jobs:
      - job: Health_Check
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Wait for Pods Ready'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                kubectl --kubeconfig $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/kubeconfig \
                  wait --for=condition=ready pod -l app=microservice --timeout=120s
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Run Health Endpoint Check'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                POD_IP=$(kubectl --kubeconfig $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/kubeconfig \
                  get pod -l app=microservice -o jsonpath='{.items[0].status.podIP}')
                curl -f http://$POD_IP/health || exit 1

  - stage: Monitor_Logs
    displayName: 'Configure Azure Monitor'
    dependsOn: Health_Check
    jobs:
      - job: Setup_Monitoring
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Enable Container Insights'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az aks enable-addons \
                  --resource-group $(resourceGroup) \
                  --name $(aksClusterName) \
                  --addons monitoring
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Query Monitor Logs'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az monitor log-analytics query \
                  --workspace $(az aks show -n $(aksClusterName) -g $(resourceGroup) \
                    --query addonProfiles.omsagent.config.logAnalyticsWorkspaceResourceID \
                    --output tsv) \
                  --query 'ContainerLog | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)'

  - stage: Promote_to_Production
    displayName: 'Promote to Production'
    dependsOn: Monitor_Logs
    condition: succeeded()
    jobs:
      - job: Production_Deploy
        displayName: 'Deploy to Production'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Promote Image to Production ACR'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az acr import \
                  --source $(acrName).azurecr.io/$(imageName) \
                  --name production-acr \
                  --image $(imageName)
          - task: Bash@3
            displayName: 'Deploy to Production AKS'
            inputs:
              targetType: 'inline'
              command: |
                kubectl config use-context production-aks
                helm upgrade --install microservice ./charts/microservice \
                  --set image.repository=production-acr.azurecr.io/$(imageName) \
                  --set appConfig.endpoint=$(APP_CONFIG_ENDPOINT_PROD) \
                  --wait --timeout 10m
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Log Promotion Event'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az monitor activity-log create \
                  --resource-group production-rg \
                  --category 'Administrative' \
                  --event-name 'PR $(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId) Merged' \
                  --description 'Production deployment completed'

  - stage: Teardown_Sandbox
    displayName: 'Teardown Sandbox'
    dependsOn: Promote_to_Production
    condition: always()
    jobs:
      - job: Cleanup
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Delete Sandbox Resource Group'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az group delete -n $(resourceGroup) --yes --no-wait || true
```

## Why This Is Asked

- Azure DevOps YAML pipelines and staging strategies

- Key Vault integration via managed identity for secrets
- Load testing with k6 for performance validation
- Gate-based promotion with latency and error rate thresholds
- Azure Monitor Logs for pipeline diagnostics

## Code Example
```yaml
trigger:
  - main

variables:
  azureServiceConnection: 'azure-sp'
  functionAppName: 'my-function-app'
  appConfigName: 'my-app-config'
  keyVaultName: 'my-key-vault'

stages:
  - stage: Build
    jobs:
      - job: Build
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: NodeTool@0
            inputs:
              versionSpec: '18.x'
          - script: npm install
          - script: npm run build
          - publish: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/dist
            artifact: drop

  - stage: Test_Audit
    dependsOn: Build
    jobs:
      - job: Test_and_Lint
        steps:
          - task: NodeTool@0
            inputs:
              versionSpec: '18.x'
          - script: npm install
          - script: npm run lint
          - script: npm test
      - job: Security_Audit
        steps:
          - task: NodeTool@0
            inputs:
              versionSpec: '18.x'
          - script: npm install
          - script: npm audit --audit-level=moderate

  - stage: Deploy_Staging
    dependsOn: Test_Audit
    variables:
      environment: 'staging'
    jobs:
      - deployment: DeployToStaging
        environment: 'staging'
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - task: AzureKeyVault@1
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    KeyVaultName: $(keyVaultName)
                    SecretsFilter: '*'
                - task: AzureAppConfiguration@1
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    AppConfigurationEndpoint: 'https://$(appConfigName).azconfig.io'
                    labels: 'staging'
                - task: AzureFunctionApp@1
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    appType: 'functionApp'
                    appName: $(functionAppName)
                    deploySlot: true
                    slotName: 'staging'
                    package: '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/dist/*.zip'

  - stage: Load_Test
    dependsOn: Deploy_Staging
    jobs:
      - job: Run_k6
        steps:
          - task: k6LoadTest@1
            inputs:
              filePath: 'tests/load-test.js'
             vus: '50'
              duration: '30s'
              threshold: 'p95=1200,error_rate=1'

  - stage: Promote_or_Rollback
    dependsOn: Load_Test
    jobs:
      - job: Check_conditions
        steps:
          - task: PowerShell@2
            inputs:
              targetType: 'inline'
              script: |
                $metrics = @{
                  p95Latency = 1150
                  errorRate = 0.5
                }
                if ($metrics.p95Latency -lt 1200 -and $metrics.errorRate -lt 1) {
                  Write-Host "Promoting to production"
                } else {
                  Write-Host "##vso[task.logissue type=error]Promote conditions not met"
                  exit 1
                }
      - job: Promote_to_Production
        dependsOn: Check_conditions
        condition: succeeded()
        steps:
          - task: AzureFunctionApp@1
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              appType: 'functionApp'
              appName: $(functionAppName)
              deploySlot: true
              slotName: 'staging'
              swapWithProduction: true
      - job: Rollback_on_Failure
        dependsOn: Check_conditions
        condition: failed()
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az functionApp deployment slot swap \
                  --resource-group my-rg \
                  --name $(functionAppName) \
                  --slot staging \
                  --target-slot production
          - task: AzureMonitor@1
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              alertsToSearch: 'all'
              insightsToSearch: 'all'
```

```yaml
          - task: NodeTool@0
            inputs:
              versionSpec: '18.x'
          - script: npm ci
            displayName: 'Install dependencies'
          - script: npm test
            displayName: 'Run unit tests'
          - script: npm run lint
            displayName: 'Run ESLint'
          - task: Docker@2
            inputs:
              command: buildAndPush
              repository: '$(ACR_LOGIN_SERVER)/app:$(Build.BuildId)'
              dockerfile: '$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/Dockerfile'
              containerRegistry: '$(ACR_SERVICE_CONNECTION)'

  - stage: Deploy
    dependsOn: Build
    condition: and(succeeded(), eq(variables['Build.Reason'], 'PullRequest'))
    jobs:
      - deployment: DeployToAKS
        environment: 'aks-pr-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestNumber)'
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - task: AzureCLI@2
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: '$(AZURE_SERVICE_CONNECTION)'
                    scriptType: 'bash'
                    scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
                    inlineScript: |
                      PR_ID=$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestNumber)
                      NAMESPACE="pr-$PR_ID"
                      kubectl create namespace $NAMESPACE --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
                      kubectl set image deployment/app app=$(ACR_LOGIN_SERVER)/app:$(Build.BuildId) -n $NAMESPACE
                      kubectl expose deployment/app --type=LoadBalancer --port=80 --target-port=3000 -n $NAMESPACE
                      sleep 30
                      SERVICE_IP=$(kubectl get svc app -n $NAMESPACE -o jsonpath='{.status.loadBalancer.ingress[0].ip}')
                      curl -f http://$SERVICE_IP/health || exit 1
                - task: AzureMonitor@1
                  inputs:
                    alertResourceGroup: '$(RESOURCE_GROUP)'
                    metricsResourceID: '$(AZURE_MONITOR_RESOURCE_ID)'
```

## Why This Is Asked
Tests PR-scoped infra, serverless deployment, and safe cleanup. It validates knowledge of Azure DevOps YAML, resource isolation, and telemetry.

## Key Concepts
- PR-scoped infrastructure
- Azure Functions deployment
- App Configuration flags
- Key Vault secrets
- RG lifecycle and cleanup
- Log Analytics auditing

## Code Example
```javascript
trigger:
  - none
pr:
  branches:
    include:
      - '*'
variables:
  prId: $(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)
  rgName: pr-$(prId)
  location: eastus
jobs:
- job: Deploy
  pool:
    vmImage: ubuntu-latest
  steps:
  - task: AzureCLI@2
    inputs:
      azureSubscription: 'AZURE-SERVICE-CONNECTION'
      scriptType: ps
      scriptLocation: inlineScript
      inlineScript: |
        az group create -n $(rgName) -l $(location)
        az functionapp create -n func-$(prId) -g $(rgName) --consumption-plan-location $(location) --runtime node
        # Attach App Configuration and Key Vault settings here
        echo 'Smoke test will target https://func-$(prId).azurewebsites.net/api/health'
        curl -sSf https://func-$(prId).azurewebsites.net/api/health
  
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you handle PR closure failures to avoid orphaned resources?
- How would you extend this to run in parallel for multiple PRs without naming collisions?
